Stored for this record: ISED's news release of 12 November 2024 (the official URL; stored 11 Oct 2026 and found unchanged since), which gives the launch, the initial CAD 50 million over five years, the home at ISED and the CIFAR and NRC research streams; and the page of Canada's National Artificial Intelligence Strategy: AI for All (secondary source), which commits a further CAD 50 million to expand the institute. The institute's own page on ised-isde.canada.ca (date modified 2026-07-08), which gives its focus, research streams, partners and publications, and ISED's news release of 5 June 2026, which dates the strategy's launch to 4 June 2026 (date_last_updated), were stored by the recheck of 17 Oct 2026.

title.quote: Canada launches Canadian Artificial Intelligence Safety Institute From: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada News release

status.quote: Today, the Honourable François-Philippe Champagne, Minister of Innovation, Science and Industry, announced the launch of the Canadian Artificial Intelligence Safety Institute (CAISI)

status.locator: Ensure Canadian AI infrastructure is safe and trustworthy, Key actions
status.quote: Canada will invest $50 million to expand the capabilities of the Canadian AI Safety Institute to track emerging AI risks, advance technical research, and to conduct transparent evaluations of AI models.

issuing_body.quote: CAISI will be housed at Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada, with a dedicated office responsible for overseeing the research agenda and engaging with international partners.
